name: gcc-timesheet-app
description: GCC Timesheet App - React client and Express API

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.graph:build: npm run graphify -- extract . --code-only --max-workers 4 && npm run graphify -- cluster-only . --no-label
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client & wait
